notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding {C}{C}.
When Palinchron dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If the lands can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.
